summary: Frontend-only regression on /games mobile (390x844) new betting terminal + desktop (1920) preservation. All specified data-testids present and functional: m-game-picker (opens m-game-picker-sheet, switching via m-pick-8/m-pick-1 works and closes sheet), top app bar with balance (100,000 gold beans), 6 tabs (home/records/mode/auto/trend/chase) - records opens m-records-dialog, mode/auto/chase/trend each open their respective dialogs, 5-item stats strip (盈亏/流水/参与期数/胜率/今日排名) visible, current draw shows numbers+SumCircle+bet range 1,000~50,000,000, countdown row shows '第 55417 期 剩128秒停止下注,168秒开奖!' and decrements every second (128→116 after ~2s wait), m-draw-table renders with 5 future rows (m-bet-*) and 20 drawn rows (m-verify-*), win/bet amount right column populated, pagination m-page-prev/m-page-next paginates 1/3 → 2/3 correctly for 60 periods, m-bottom-nav 5 icons all navigable (m-bottom-home successfully routed to /). Desktop 1920: mobile picker hidden, original GameNav + toolbar + DrawInfoBar + HistoryTable + pagination preserved, no mobile terminal leakage. Screenshots confirm layouts match spec.

issues: Top bar is sticky at top-14 (below global 56px header) which is expected, but the global header is still visible above the mobile game bar — screenshot shows both '胜利28' header AND dense game bar. If the design intent was full-screen terminal, consider hiding global header on mobile /games; currently acceptable.
BackToTop and m-bottom-nav may overlap (noted as acceptable in agent-to-agent context).

critical_code_review_comments: MobileGameArena.jsx is ~290 lines, mixes 5+ concerns (picker sheet, records dialog, tabs, pager, bottom nav, stats). Consider extracting BottomNav, GamePickerSheet, RecordsDialog to standalone components for reuse and to keep file <200 lines.
Countdown logic uses hardcoded 170s cycle & 40s bet-stop offset; not tied to real nextPeriod kjtime → visual only. Acceptable since spec says '展示层'.
SumCircle uses only 2 colors (red/blue) — spec notes 3-color spec not strictly replicated; keep as-is per agent note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified /games mobile terminal rewrite. All data-testids used: m-game-picker, m-game-picker-sheet, m-pick-{id}, m-tab-{home|records|mode|auto|trend|chase}, m-draw-table, m-draw-row-{period}, m-verify-{period}, m-bet-{period}, m-page-prev, m-page-next, m-bottom-{home|agent|games|shop|me}, m-records-dialog. Desktop preserved via 'hidden md:block'. Countdown ticks correctly. No backend testing performed (frontend only per request).
